edges.reason: msg.sender is written into owner during the Owned constructor, establishing privileged control.
The Owned constructor performs the state write to owner.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner in transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the pending newOwner.
transferOwnership writes the new pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads and clears newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller controls the source of funds.
transfer calls safeSub for the sender balance decrement.
transfer calls safeAdd for the recipient balance increment.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] under caller control.
approve updates the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender], making the caller the spending authority.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance increment.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom consumes the allowed allowance mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall grants an allowance based on msg.sender as the owner.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external callback.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the untrusted spender contract.
The external callee can re-enter the token and act on or observe allowance state while approveAndCall has not returned.
Caller-supplied data bytes are forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner check on msg.sender.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to a caller-supplied token contract.
The owner address is passed as the recipient of the external token transfer.

totalSupply executes a raw unchecked subtraction instead of using SafeMath.
